title: English Practice Quiz 0917
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: An incident report should primarily contain ___.
questions.explanation: factual details of what happened is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Which details are essential in an incident record?
questions.explanation: Date, time and location is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A chronological account presents events ___.
questions.explanation: in the order they occurred is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An unconfirmed fact should be described as ___.
questions.explanation: unverified or pending confirmation is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An objective report avoids ___.
questions.explanation: emotional language and unsupported assumptions is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A recommendation section should suggest ___.
questions.explanation: practical actions based on findings is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A report reference number helps with ___.
questions.explanation: identifying and retrieving the record is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Why make report corrections traceable?
options: To preserve an accurate record of changes
questions.explanation: To preserve an accurate record of changes is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An executive summary presents ___.
questions.explanation: main findings and key actions is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before submitting a report, verify ___.
options: names, dates, figures and supporting evidence
questions.explanation: names, dates, figures and supporting evidence is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
